intended_object: The split exceptional simple Lie algebra of type E₇ over a commutative ring R. It is presented by Chevalley–Serre generators H_i, E_i, F_i (i = 1..7) subject to the Serre relations for the E₇ Cartan matrix. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: `Matrix.ToLieAlgebra R CM` is the free Lie algebra on the generators H_i, E_i, F_i, divided by the Lie ideal spanned by the Serre relations: [H_i,H_j]=0; [E_i,F_i]=H_i; [E_i,F_j]=0 for i≠j; [H_i,E_j]=A_ij E_j; [H_i,F_j]=-A_ij F_j; and ad(E_i)^{-A_ij}[E_i,E_j]=0, which is the usual ad(E_i)^{1-A_ij}E_j=0 (likewise for F). When i=j that last relation holds trivially, so including the diagonal is harmless. `CartanMatrix.E 7` is checked by `decide` in `E_seven_eq` to equal Bourbaki's E₇ Cartan matrix (plate VI); the matrix is symmetric, so the row/column convention is irrelevant. The construction works over any commutative ring, the same generality Mathlib uses for e₆, e₈, f₄, g₂ and the families aₙ to dₙ, so it is not too narrow. The index type Fin 7 is inherent to a specific Cartan matrix.
